description: Free, no API key. Looks up one product by its official registration number in a country's register: authorisation state (authorised / withdrawn / expired), expiry date, formulation, active substances and authorised uses. With crop_eppo it also says whether the product is authorised on that crop. Includes a link to the product page.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose official register to use, e.g. ES, FR, DE, IT, PT, PL

crop_eppo.description: EPPO code of the crop to check the product against, e.g. VITVI (grapevine), OLVEU (olive)

name: check_plant_protection_product
title: Check a plant protection product
